argv:
set -eo pipefail
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/set_env.sh
export PYTHONPATH=/audit/build/python_deps:${PYTHONPATH:-}
export PATH=/buildtools:${PATH}
export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=4
cd /audit/source/ops-transformer-v9.1.0
JSON_INCLUDE=/audit/source/ops-transformer-v9.1.0/third_party/json/single_include
g++ -std=c++17 -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 -I${JSON_INCLUDE} -I/usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/include -x c++ -fsyntax-only attention/flash_attention_score/op_host/fa_bridge.h
g++ -std=c++17 -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 -I${JSON_INCLUDE} -I/audit/native /audit/native/test_fa_plan.cpp -o /audit/build/evidence_a1/test_fa_plan
/audit/build/evidence_a1/test_fa_plan > /audit/build/evidence_a1/plan_cpu_checks.json
g++ -std=c++17 -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 -I${JSON_INCLUDE} -I/audit/native -I/usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/include /audit/native/test_fa_bridge_scope.cpp -L/usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/lib64 -lregister -o /audit/build/evidence_a1/test_fa_bridge_scope
/audit/build/evidence_a1/test_fa_bridge_scope /audit/native/cpu_fixture_plan.json > /audit/build/evidence_a1/scope_cpu_checks.json
g++ -std=c++17 -Iattention/flash_attention_score/op_kernel/arch22 -I/usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/aarch64-linux/ascendc/include/highlevel_api -I/usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/include /audit/native/fa_pod_decoder.cpp -o /audit/build/evidence_a1/fa_pod_decoder
/audit/build/evidence_a1/fa_pod_decoder --schema > /audit/build/evidence_a1/fa_pod_schema.json
/audit/build/evidence_a1/fa_pod_decoder --self-test > /audit/build/evidence_a1/fa_pod_selftest.json
cmake -S . -B build -DENABLE_BUILD_PKG=ON -DBUILD_OPEN_PROJECT=ON -DBUILD_WITH_INSTALLED_DEPENDENCY_CANN_PKG=ON -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=OFF -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=ON -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=OFF -DENABLE_AICPU=OFF -DENABLE_AICPU_KERNEL=OFF -DENABLE_TEST=OFF -DENABLE_CCACHE=ON -DBUILD_OPS_RTY_KERNEL=OFF -DVENDOR_NAME=native_execution_strategy -DASCEND_OP_NAME=flash_attention_score -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=ascend910b -DCUSTOM_ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0 -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3.11 -DHI_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3.11 -DASCEND_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3.11 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/audit/source/ops-transformer-v9.1.0/build_out
cmake --build build --target package --parallel 4
